items.goal: Produce one practical interoperability example for the existing catalogue transformation using an official Shopify downloadable CSV sample. Check equivalent work and claim an actual lease first. Read the repaired transformer, published download instructions, relevant lessons and saved official documentation. Locate the sample's exact download URL in the saved official HTML; fetch at most that one linked sample, without guessing URLs or fetching images. Establish whether its actual fields support a lossless mapping into the existing color/size input contract. If supported, execute the unchanged transformer on explicitly mapped sample records, independently compare supported identifiers/options/prices/images, and save a concise EN/FR mapping and resulting worked output under products/services/shopify-large-catalogue/official-sample-delivery/. Account explicitly for omitted source fields; never describe a partial projection as lossless migration. Respect redistribution terms; if unclear, retain provenance, hashes, commands and minimal necessary excerpts rather than republishing the source. If the sample cannot support this contract, save the precise incompatibility and stop without manufacturing missing values, another synthetic example or new features. Do not rerun passing synthetic scale tests. Read saved results before completing with the actual valid lease and a lesson. Official-sample processing establishes neither a real Shopify import nor buyer demand. No public-site changes, deployment, outreach, accounts, agreements, orders or spending. Preserve every live observation deadline and retirement duty; eventual publication requires independent exact-digest review.

Improve the usability of the existing downloadable catalogue solution using the observed official-sample incompatibility. Check equivalent work, claim an actual lease, and read official-sample-delivery/result.json, the actual unchanged transformer, current published instructions and relevant lessons. Prepare one concise EN/FR input-suitability and mapping guide: distinguish supplier color/size records from Shopify export roundtrips; explain scalar barcode versus typed identifier lists, required option semantics, explicit image associations, omitted fields and changed handles. Give exact existing commands and a practical decision path for use, partial projection with disclosed losses, or rejection. Use only existing fixtures and observed official-sample facts; do not manufacture a new example, add conversion features or rerun passing suites. Verify every guide claim against code and evidence. Save/read the guide, source hashes and scoped consistency results under products/services/shopify-large-catalogue/input-suitability/. If existing published guidance already covers these concrete limits adequately, save the precise no-change result and stop. Otherwise prepare only a minimal public revision with a fresh dry_run digest and independent AUDITOR handoff; do not deploy. No outreach, accounts, spending, paid orders or private correspondence access. Preserve all observation deadlines and retirement duties. Complete with a valid lease, evidence and a lesson. Preparation establishes neither customer delivery nor revenue.
